uniqueness.difference: a clock filter: it carries no market information, only the hour. Prior reads on hours (MKTTIME1) were gold and Bitcoin specific and read by hand; this is the whole grid on every series. Weekend and holiday effects are not separated (a weekend hour is the same band as a weekday one); a day-of-week split would be its own spec.
uniqueness.family_flag: none identified (a clock band is not an entry mechanism); a pass is a regime tag, never a standalone strategy
